rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary piece of work or work assignment.

example.english: I still haven't finished this task today.
example.traditional: 我今日仲未做完呢份工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zung6 mei6 zou6 jyun4 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this for an explicitly assigned task, mission, or duty rather than ordinary work in general.

example.english: We must complete this task today.
example.traditional: 呢項任務我哋一定要喺今日完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 jam6 mou6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hai2 gam1 jat6 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this when task means the objective or result to be achieved, not the work itself.

example.english: Our task today is to finish the report.
example.traditional: 我哋今日嘅目標係完成份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 jyun4 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this for a difficult, tedious, or unpleasant undertaking.

example.english: Moving all these boxes is a tedious task.
example.traditional: 搬晒呢堆箱真係苦差事。
example.jyutping: bun1 saai3 ni1 deoi1 soeng1 zan1 hai6 fu2 caai1 si6
